name: Congleton Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Astbury Chapel. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Cheshire East Council Allotments
short_description: Cheshire East Council allotment sites in Congleton area
image: and West Heath. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Congleton Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run community garden at Astbury Mere Country Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
